name: seastate
description: Live coastal conditions dashboard for a single beach: NOAA buoy, tide, water temperature, and swell data on one page.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
